Struct.Name: Long Message Header
Struct.Description: The guide states these fields once, as Table 3: Long Message Header, for every message the eight Table 2 frames do not. Sequence Number and Message Type are read by the packet, so they are not repeated here.

Struct.Name: Option Symbol
Struct.Description: The guide states the option symbol once and every option message carries it.

Struct.Name: Future Option Symbol
Struct.Description: The guide states the future option symbol once and every future options message carries it.

Struct.Name: Future Product
Struct.Description: The guide states the future product once and every futures message carries it.

Field.Name: Root Symbol
Field.Description: Associated product's class symbol

Field.Name: Symbol Month
Field.Description: Symbol month

Field.Name: Symbol Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the symbol year

Field.Name: Expiry Day
Field.Description: Expiry day

Struct.Name: Regular Text Bulletin
Struct.Description: Bulletin Type 1, which the Bulletin Type field selects.

Struct.Name: Special Text Bulletin
Struct.Description: Bulletin Type 2, which the Bulletin Type field selects and which names a trading instrument.

Group.Name: Market Depth Level
Group.Description: One level of market depth. The guide prints Ask Price as N for futures alone, where every other depth message prints X; read as N it could not hold the indicator codes its own description refers to, so it is marked y, an Omi type.

Group.Name: Strategy Market Depth Level
Group.Description: One level of strategy market depth, which carries a sign with each price.

Group.Name: Strategy Instrument Leg
Group.Description: One leg of a strategy instrument.
